settings.normalizeDesc: Automatically adjust playback volume by track loudness: ReplayGain tags embedded in the audio are preferred; tracks without tags are analyzed in the background on first play and persisted. Prevents big volume jumps between songs.
settings.normalizeEnableHint: Target loudness -14 LUFS with peak protection; applied in real time and persisted

settings.lyricsDesc2: Per-line offset correction is done at the bottom of the lyrics panel and saved per track.
settings.onlineDesc: Online services are off by default; when enabled they are used on demand, and the local library is not uploaded by default.
settings.onlineEnableHint: Enables online source and lyrics matching (landing in M3)
settings.allowUploadHint: Improves online matching accuracy; off by default and requires separate consent
settings.providerMore: More providers will be added in M3
settings.windowCloseDesc: Controls what happens when you click the X in the top-right corner; applied immediately and persisted.

settings.updateDesc: Current version: {version}. Update packages are verified by digital signature and obtained only from the official release channel. Downloads and installation require your manual confirmation; no silent upgrades.
settings.unsupported: In-app updates are not supported in the browser preview; please use the installed TPlayer.
settings.installNote: When the download finishes the installer launches automatically and the app restarts with the new version.
settings.depsDesc: FFmpeg / FFprobe / SACD Extract are third-party components required to play DSD, SACD, APE, WMA and more, installed as a separate package into a shared directory. Install once and use long-term; the package is not removed when the main app updates and does not need re-downloading on every update. Common formats (MP3 / FLAC / WAV / AAC) do not depend on these components.
settings.officialDesc: Visit the TPlayer website for release notes, help and the latest news. It was opened automatically once after the first install, will not pop up again, and you can open it here anytime.
settings.aboutIntro: TPlayer is a local-first desktop music player built with Tauri 2, Vue 3 and Rust. All track data, play history, favorites and playlists are stored in a local SQLite database (%APPDATA%\com.tplayer); library management and playback work without any cloud service. Online features (lyrics matching, cover completion, metadata recognition) are optional enhancements, off by default and used on demand when enabled; uploading local library features still requires separate consent.
settings.aboutPrivacyText: Library files, favorites, playlists and play history are stored only on this machine (%APPDATA%\com.tplayer). The app never uploads your track information; online enhancements such as lyrics and covers are off by default, and even when enabled manually, uploading local library features still requires separate consent.
settings.aboutThanksText1: Thanks to rodio / Symphonia (audio decoding), lofty (tag reading), FFmpeg (format decoding and conversion), minisign (update signing), Vue and Tauri, and other open-source projects.
settings.aboutThanksText2: Special thanks to Gleeisen Wine, Qian Weicheng, Jiemodun'er, An'an and Youlan for their support and help with the project.
settings.featFormatDesc: 18 audio formats including MP3, FLAC, WAV, AAC, OGG/Opus, M4A, WMA, APE, WV, TTA, TAK, DSF/DFF (DSD) and DTS; playback is primarily direct decoding, with complex formats like DSD decoded to PCM by the ffmpeg engine (no transcoding to disk), compatible with most sound cards.
settings.featPlaybackDesc: Play queue, crossfade (0–3 s), multiple play modes (sequential/single/shuffle/list loop), volume normalization (ReplayGain, target -14 LUFS), tray controls and global shortcuts.
settings.featLibraryDesc: Multi-folder whitelist and incremental scanning (only changed files are re-parsed), automatic album/artist aggregation, multi-track album detection (CUE indexes and SACD ISO are parsed into multi-track virtual albums), and metadata enhancement (tags first, sidecar file detection, filename splitting).
settings.featLyricsDesc: LRC lyrics with per-line offset correction (saved per track); automatic cover matching (embedded tags → same-name image → folder cover → optional online completion), with the UI skin generated from the cover's dominant color (ambience mode).
settings.featHistoryDesc: Favorites, recently played, custom playlists, and listening reports (play duration / frequency statistics).
settings.featPerfDesc: Virtual scrolling and SQLite persistence for libraries with tens of thousands of tracks for faster startup and browsing; folder auto-watch detects library changes in the background without manual rescans.
settings.featUpdateDesc: Silently checks for updates once a day after startup and prompts when a new version is found; after confirmation it downloads (with progress, retry and resume) and installs, then shows "You're up to date". Update packages are verified by digital signature and installed only after manual confirmation — no silent upgrades; you can also check manually in Settings → Updates.
settings.featLabDesc: Equalizer (10 bands, ±15 dB, multiple presets), skin colors (accent color / window backdrop / gradient / texture), custom wallpaper (local / daily Bing), metadata enhancement (online validation to fill unknown fields), and CUE/SACD track splitting. All are off by default, isolated from existing features, and merged into the stable release once mature.
settings.resetDesc: Resets language, library folders, online services and all other settings (does not affect library files, favorites or play history; theme unchanged).
